title: observability: token-level cost/latency tracing dashboard and alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds token-level cost and latency tracing dashboard, refines alert thresholds to reduce noise, and exposes new token-level metrics for per-route/model cost analysis.
description: Motivation: customers operating at scale need per-token visibility into latency and cost to diagnose hotpaths, quantify KV cache effectiveness, and correlate token-level spikes with model or routing changes. This PR implements token-level metrics and tracing hooks, a Grafana dashboard for cost/latency breakdowns, and alert tuning to reduce false positives. Summary of changes: 1) Instrumentation: add OpenTelemetry spans around tokenization, model inference, KV cache lookup, and response streaming to emit token-level traces and metrics. 2) Metrics: introduce redwood_token_latency_ms (histogram), redwood_token_cost_usd (counter/gauge derived via pricing model), redwood_token_kv_cache_hit (counter), with labels model, route, customer_tier, hardware_class. 3) Exporter: batch-friendly token metrics exporter that aggregates per-request to avoid cardinality explosion and exposes route/model rollups. 4) Dashboards: new Grafana dashboard with panels for per-model token cost, rolling 5m/1h token latency percentiles, KV cache hit rate impact on cost, and trace sampling viewer links. 5) Alerts: tuned latency and cost alerts using rate-of-change and burn-in windows to avoid alerts on rollout churn; added escalation policy integration with #ops-llm and PagerDuty. 6) Tests and docs: unit tests for metric aggregation, integration tests for Prometheus scrape, and docs for interpreting dashboard panels. Backwards compatibility: metrics keep previous names for aggregated endpoints; new labels are optional. Linked tickets: ENG-3214, ENG-3301, SUP-4432. Migration notes: provide additional Prometheus scrape config and increase trace retention for 7 days for token traces.
commits_summary: a1f9d3c: add token metrics collector and histogram buckets for latency
b2c8e4a: add Grafana dashboard yaml and dashboard variables for model/route selection
c3d7f5b: tune alert rules and add burn-in/rate-of-change condition; add docs and tests
review_thread: Miguel Torres: Nice work, can you reduce the cardinality risk from free-form route labels? Suggest normalizing to route_id or route_group.
Aisha Patel: Good call. I added route_group and keep route_name as a low-cardinality label and updated the exporter aggregation to rollup by route_group.
Elliot Kim: Alert thresholds look reasonable but we should add a short hold time to avoid flapping during canary rollouts.
Aisha Patel: Added a 10m burn-in window and a rate-of-change check as requested. Also added a dashboard note explaining canary behavior.
Rina Sharma: Verified dashboards and test coverage in local staging. Approving for merge after CI passes.
CI: all checks passed on rerun (lint, unit, e2e).
